item.title: 【Helpdesk】How Rip VHS TV Master tapes
item.description:
Well, my father worked at MTV LATAM as an editor, and he left me a large collection of VHS TV master tapes of his favorite bands, The Strokes, Green Day, and Nirvana, as well as recordings of old concerts by these bands, but without a single compressed or lost file. My friends have told me to sell them, which I think is stupid. In my opinion, I'd rather upload them to the internet. I like to collect bootlegs and concerts from my favorite bands too. They're VHS tapes, and I don't know how to rip them. I'm 23 years old, so I don't know how a blessed VHS works. Therefore, I'm asking this community to guide me in ripping these tapes without losing a single bit of quality. I only can rip a VHS one year ago and its from The Strokes
